exercises.name: Wall Sit
exercises.description: Back flat against wall, slide down until thighs are parallel. Hold 30–60s.

exercises.name: Seated Leg Extension (Light)
exercises.description: Light resistance only. Full ROM with slow tempo. Do NOT lock knee at top.

exercises.name: Straight-Leg Raise
exercises.description: Lie on back, lock knee straight, raise 45°. Great for knee rehab without joint stress.

exercises.name: Terminal Knee Extension (TKE)
exercises.description: Band behind knee, extend from 30° to full extension. VMO activation focus.

exercises.name: Step-Up (Low Box)
exercises.description: Step onto a 20cm box. Control descent. Great for knee rehab proprioception.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat (Shallow)
exercises.description: Hold dumbbell at chest, squat to 60°–70° only. Upright torso cue.

exercises.name: Split Squat (Rear-foot elevated)
exercises.description: Rear foot on bench. Front knee tracks over toes. Not suitable for active knee injury.

exercises.name: Leg Press (Moderate)
exercises.description: Feet hip-width, 90° knee angle limit. Avoid for deep knee pain.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift (Dumbbell)
exercises.description: Hip hinge with neutral spine. Keep DBs close to legs. Not for acute lower-back.

exercises.name: Nordic Hamstring Curl
exercises.description: Eccentric hamstring exercise. Very high load — avoid in acute hamstring strain.

exercises.name: Lying Leg Curl
exercises.description: Full ROM leg curl. Avoid heavy loads for acute hamstring injury.

exercises.name: Hip Thrust (Bodyweight)
exercises.description: Shoulders on bench edge, drive hips up. Excellent for glute activation.

exercises.name: Hip Thrust (Barbell)
exercises.description: Loaded hip thrust. Avoid for acute hip flexor or SI joint pain.

exercises.name: Clamshell
exercises.description: Side-lying hip abduction with band. Essential glute medius rehab.

exercises.name: Band Walk (Lateral)
exercises.description: Band around ankles, side-step keeping slight squat. Hip stabilizer activation.

exercises.name: Barbell Back Squat
exercises.description: High-bar or low-bar squat. Avoid for knee or hip injury.

exercises.name: Conventional Deadlift
exercises.description: Full-body pull. Neutral spine essential. Contraindicated for lower-back injury.

exercises.name: Lunge (Walking)
exercises.description: Dynamic lunge. Avoid for knee or hip injury.

exercises.name: Box Jump
exercises.description: Plyometric power exercise. Contraindicated for knee, ankle, hip injury.

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raise
exercises.description: Full ROM plantar flexion. Avoid for calf strain or Achilles issues.

exercises.name: Seated Calf Raise
exercises.description: Targets soleus. Less stress on Achilles than standing version.

exercises.name: Ankle Alphabet
exercises.description: Trace alphabet with toes in air. Ankle ROM and proprioception rehab.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Balance
exercises.description: Balance 30–60s each leg. Progress to eyes closed. Ankle/knee proprioception.

exercises.name: Bench Press (Barbell)
exercises.description: Flat bench press. Avoid for shoulder impingement or rib injury.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Bench Press
exercises.description: Allows more natural wrist alignment than barbell. Less shoulder stress.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
exercises.description: 30–45° incline. Upper chest focus. Avoid for shoulder pain.

exercises.name: Cable Fly
exercises.description: Constant tension fly. Avoid for rib or shoulder injury.

exercises.name: Push-Up
exercises.description: Classic push-up. Avoid for wrist or chest/rib injury.

exercises.name: Wall Push-Up
exercises.description: Standing push against wall. Very low load — suitable early in rehab.

exercises.name: Dip (Chest)
exercises.description: High shoulder demand. Contraindicated for shoulder or rib injury.

exercises.name: Overhead Press (Barbell)
exercises.description: Strict military press. Contraindicated for shoulder, neck, or wrist injury.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
exercises.description: Raise arms to shoulder height, slight elbow bend. Avoid impingement range (>90°).

exercises.name: Cable Lateral Raise
exercises.description: Constant tension. More controlled than dumbbell version.

exercises.name: Face Pull
exercises.description: Pull to face with external rotation. Essential for shoulder health.

exercises.name: Band External Rotation
exercises.description: Elbow at side, rotate arm outward against band. Rotator cuff strengthening.

exercises.name: Pendulum (Codman) Exercise
exercises.description: Lean forward, let arm hang and swing in circles. Post-surgery shoulder rehab.

exercises.name: Seated Dumbbell Press
exercises.description: Seated for stability. Avoid for shoulder impingement or neck pain.

exercises.name: Pull-Up
exercises.description: Overhand grip pull-up. Full ROM. Avoid if shoulder is inflamed.

exercises.name: Chin-Up
exercises.description: Underhand grip. More bicep involvement. Elbow-friendly variant.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown (Neutral Grip)
exercises.description: Palms facing each other. Shoulder-friendly variant. Avoid wide-grip for shoulder.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown (Wide Grip)
exercises.description: Avoid for shoulder impingement. Neutral grip preferred.

exercises.name: Seated Cable Row
exercises.description: Keep chest up, row to lower sternum. Safe for most back conditions.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Row (Single-arm)
exercises.description: Knee on bench, pull DB to hip. Neutral spine throughout.

exercises.name: Bent-Over Row (Barbell)
exercises.description: High lower-back demand. Avoid for lower-back injury.

exercises.name: Band Pull-Apart
exercises.description: Pull band apart at chest height. Upper back and shoulder health.

exercises.name: Superman
exercises.description: Prone back extension with arm lift. Low-load spinal extensor activation.

exercises.name: Bird-Dog
exercises.description: Opposite arm-leg raise from quadruped. Core stability without spinal load.

exercises.name: Dead Bug
exercises.description: Supine opposite arm-leg extension. Safe for lower-back rehab.

exercises.name: McGill Big Three: Curl-Up
exercises.description: Minimal spinal flexion curl-up. Preferred over sit-ups for lower-back rehab.

exercises.name: McGill Big Three: Side Plank
exercises.description: Lateral core stability. One of McGill's evidence-based back exercises.

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.description: Hold rigid position. Avoid for wrist injury; use forearm plank instead.

exercises.name: Forearm Plank
exercises.description: Wrist-friendly plank variant. Elbows on ground.

exercises.name: Hollow Body Hold
exercises.description: Press lower back into floor, arms and legs hover. Deep core tension.

exercises.name: Sit-Up
exercises.description: Full sit-up with spinal flexion. Avoid for lower-back injury.

exercises.name: Hanging Leg Raise
exercises.description: High spinal flexion load. Avoid for lower-back injury.

exercises.name: Barbell Bicep Curl
exercises.description: Standard curl. Avoid for wrist or elbow injury.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Bicep Curl
exercises.description: Natural wrist alignment. Hammer or supination curl variations.

exercises.name: Hammer Curl
exercises.description: Neutral grip curl. Reduced wrist stress vs. supinated curl.

exercises.name: Cable Bicep Curl
exercises.description: Constant tension curl. Use rope or bar attachment.

exercises.name: Preacher Curl
exercises.description: High elbow stress at full extension. Avoid for elbow injury.

exercises.name: Tricep Pushdown (Cable)
exercises.description: Elbow stays fixed. Rope or bar attachment. Safe for most conditions.

exercises.name: Overhead Tricep Extension (Dumbbell)
exercises.description: Long head emphasis. Avoid for elbow or shoulder injury.

exercises.name: Skull Crusher
exercises.description: Lying EZ-bar extension. High elbow stress. Avoid for elbow tendinitis.

exercises.name: Tricep Dip (Bench)
exercises.description: Hands on bench behind body. High shoulder demand. Avoid for shoulder/elbow.

exercises.name: Barbell Shrug
exercises.description: Avoid heavy loads for neck injury. Light DB shrugs safer option.

exercises.name: Upright Row
exercises.description: High shoulder impingement risk. Generally avoided for shoulder issues.

exercises.name: Neck Flexion/Extension (Isometric)
exercises.description: Press hand against head, resist without movement. Cervical stabilizer activation.

exercises.name: Neck Stretch (Levator Scapulae)
exercises.description: Gentle neck stretch. Hold 30s each side. No loaded movements.

exercises.name: Chin Tuck
exercises.description: Retract chin to make double chin. Deep neck flexor activation. Safe.

exercises.name: Wrist Flexor Stretch
exercises.description: Extend arm, pull fingers back gently. Forearm and wrist mobility.

exercises.name: Wrist Extension (Light)
exercises.description: Very light DB wrist extension. For golfer's elbow or wrist rehab.

exercises.name: Reverse Curl (Light)
exercises.description: Pronated grip curl. Elbow and forearm extensor rehab.

exercises.name: Elbow Flexion (Isometric)
exercises.description: Press hand against fixed surface, no movement. Tendinitis-safe activation.

exercises.name: Foam Roll (Quads)
exercises.description: Roll quads for 60–90s. Reduces DOMS and improves tissue quality.

exercises.name: Foam Roll (IT Band)
exercises.description: Side-lying roll from hip to knee. IT band and lateral quad mobility.

exercises.name: Foam Roll (Thoracic Spine)
exercises.description: Thoracic extension over roller. Improves posture and shoulder mobility.

exercises.name: Hip Flexor Stretch (Kneeling)
exercises.description: Half-kneeling stretch. Hold 30–60s. Essential for desk workers.

exercises.name: Pigeon Stretch
exercises.description: Hip external rotation stretch. Floor or standing variant.

exercises.name: Cat-Cow Stretch
exercises.description: Quadruped spinal flexion-extension. Safe warm-up for the spine.

exercises.name: World's Greatest Stretch
exercises.description: Dynamic lunge + thoracic rotation. Full-body warm-up movement.

exercises.name: 90/90 Hip Stretch
exercises.description: Seated 90/90 position. Hip mobility in both internal and external rotation.

exercises.name: Jefferson Curl
exercises.description: Loaded spinal flexion mobility. Contraindicated for lower-back injury.

exercises.name: Glute Bridge
exercises.description: Supine hip extension. Safe activation for glutes without knee stress.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Glute Bridge
exercises.description: Unilateral glute bridge. Increases difficulty and hip stability demand.

exercises.name: Good Morning
exercises.description: Hip hinge with bar on shoulders. High spinal load. Avoid for lower-back.

exercises.name: Hyperextension (Back Extension)
exercises.description: 45° back extension. Avoid loaded version for acute lower-back pain.

exercises.name: Cable Woodchop (Low to High)
exercises.description: Rotational core exercise. Keep back neutral. Good for functional core.

exercises.name: Pallof Press
exercises.description: Anti-rotation core exercise. Excellent for lower-back rehab.

exercises.name: Farmer's Carry
exercises.description: Walk with heavy objects. Full-body stability. Avoid heavy loads for wrist.

exercises.name: Turkish Get-Up
exercises.description: Complex multi-joint movement. Overhead stability and mobility.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Swing
exercises.description: Hip hinge-powered swing. High power output. Avoid for lower-back injury.

exercises.name: Battle Ropes
exercises.description: Upper-body HIIT. Various wave, slam, circle patterns.

exercises.name: Rowing Machine
exercises.description: Full-body low-impact cardio. Excellent for lower-body injury as substitute.

exercises.name: Stationary Bike
exercises.description: Low-impact cardio. Safe for knee rehab at moderate resistance.

exercises.name: Elliptical Trainer
exercises.description: No-impact cardio. Very safe for knee, hip, and ankle recovery.

exercises.name: Swimming (Freestyle)
exercises.description: Zero-impact full-body cardio. Excellent for most injury conditions.

exercises.name: Incline Walk (Treadmill)
exercises.description: Walking at 10–15% incline. Low-impact glute and cardio activation.

exercises.name: Running
exercises.description: High-impact. Contraindicated for knee, ankle, and calf injury.

exercises.name: Jumping Jack
exercises.description: Classic warm-up. Avoid for knee, ankle, or hip injury.

exercises.name: Mountain Climber
exercises.description: Running knees to chest from plank. Core and cardio combo.

exercises.name: Burpee
exercises.description: High-intensity full-body. Multiple contraindications — avoid for injury.

exercises.name: Stair Climber Machine
exercises.description: Step-based cardio. Moderate knee stress. Use for low-level knee rehab only.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Goblet Squat (Full Depth)
exercises.description: Full depth squat. Avoid for knee injury.

exercises.name: Hack Squat Machine
exercises.description: Machine squat with back support. Avoid deep knee flexion for injury.

exercises.name: Pec Deck Machine
exercises.description: Chest fly machine. Avoid for shoulder or rib injury.

exercises.name: Smith Machine Squat
exercises.description: Guided squat. More stable than free barbell. Avoid deep for knee.

exercises.name: Smith Machine Bench Press
exercises.description: Guided bench. Useful when training alone. Same shoulder cautions apply.

exercises.name: Prone Hip Extension
exercises.description: Prone position, lift one leg slightly off floor. Glute activation without load.

exercises.name: Seated Hip Abduction (Machine)
exercises.description: Machine hip abduction. Safe for most conditions including knee rehab.

exercises.name: Standing Hip Abduction (Band)
exercises.description: Stand with band around ankles, raise leg outward. Glute medius.

exercises.name: Hip Internal Rotation (Band)
exercises.description: Seated or standing hip IR with band resistance. Hip stability.

exercises.name: Prone Plank to Downward Dog
exercises.description: Flow between plank and pike. Full-body mobility warm-up.

exercises.name: Deep Squat Hold (Goblet Assist)
exercises.description: Hold bottom of squat for 2–3 min. Mobility only, no knee injury.

exercises.name: Lateral Band Walk (Squatted)
exercises.description: Squat position lateral walk. Hip abductor and glute medius activation.

exercises.name: Sissy Squat
exercises.description: Extreme quad isolation. High knee stress. Avoid for any knee condition.

exercises.name: Wall Angel
exercises.description: Stand against wall, slide arms up-down. Shoulder posture correction.

exercises.name: Sleeper Stretch
exercises.description: Side-lying internal rotation stretch. Posterior shoulder tightness rehab.

exercises.name: YTWL Exercise (Band)
exercises.description: Four positions targeting scapular stabilizers. Essential shoulder rehab.

exercises.name: Thoracic Rotation Stretch
exercises.description: Seated or quadruped thoracic rotation. Improves upper-back mobility.

exercises.name: Hip 90/90 Internal Rotation (Active)
exercises.description: Active hip IR in 90/90. Improves hip mobility for squat patterns.

exercises.name: Scapular Push-Up
exercises.description: Only scapular protraction, no elbow bend. Serratus activation.

exercises.name: Chest-Supported Row (Dumbbell)
exercises.description: Prone on incline bench. Removes lower-back from equation.

exercises.name: Meadows Row (Landmine)
exercises.description: Unilateral landmine row. Less lower-back stress than bent-over row.

exercises.name: Close-Grip Bench Press
exercises.description: Tricep-focused bench. Elbow stress at lockout. Avoid for elbow injury.

exercises.name: Arnold Press
exercises.description: Rotating shoulder press. High ROM demand. Avoid for shoulder injury.

exercises.name: Rear Delt Fly (Dumbbell)
exercises.description: Bent-over lateral raise. Rear delt isolation. Safe for most.

exercises.name: Ankle Dorsiflexion Mobilization
exercises.description: Band-assisted ankle dorsiflexion. Essential pre-squat and ankle rehab.

exercises.name: Towel Toe Curls
exercises.description: Curl towel with toes. Foot intrinsic strengthening for plantar fasciitis.

exercises.name: Side-Lying Hip External Rotation
exercises.description: Hip ER in side-lying. Piriformis and deep hip rotator activation.

exercises.name: Quadruped Hip Extension with Knee Bend
exercises.description: All-fours hip kick back with 90° knee. Glute isolation, minimal knee stress.

exercises.name: Wall Hip Flexor Mobilization
exercises.description: Lunge with back foot on wall. Deep hip flexor stretch and activation.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
exercises.description: Seated on incline, arms hang. Full bicep stretch at bottom.

exercises.name: Cable Face Pull with External Rotation
exercises.description: End of face pull with ER. Comprehensive rotator cuff rehab.

exercises.name: Standing Hip Circle (Mobility)
exercises.description: Standing large hip circles. Hip joint lubrication warm-up.

exercises.name: Leg Swings (Forward/Back)
exercises.description: Dynamic hamstring and hip flexor warm-up.

exercises.name: Leg Swings (Lateral)
exercises.description: Dynamic hip abductor and adductor warm-up.

exercises.name: Arm Circle
exercises.description: Forward and backward arm circles. Shoulder warm-up.

exercises.name: Neck Rotation (Gentle)
exercises.description: Slow chin to shoulder rotation. Never force range of motion.

exercises.name: Wrist Circles
exercises.description: Full wrist circumduction. Pre-workout wrist mobility.

exercises.name: Ankle Circles
exercises.description: Full ankle circumduction. Pre-workout ankle mobility.

exercises.name: Child's Pose
exercises.description: Knees wide, arms extended forward. Full-body cool-down stretch.

exercises.name: Seated Hamstring Stretch
exercises.description: Long sit with forward lean. Hold 30–60s.

exercises.name: Standing Quad Stretch
exercises.description: Hold ankle behind, stand on one leg. Quad stretch.

exercises.name: Doorway Chest Stretch
exercises.description: Hands on doorframe, lean forward gently. Chest and shoulder opener.

exercises.name: Tricep Overhead Stretch
exercises.description: Reach behind head with one arm. Tricep and lat stretch.

exercises.name: Cross-Body Shoulder Stretch
exercises.description: Pull arm across body. Posterior shoulder stretch.

exercises.name: Calf Stretch (Wall)
exercises.description: Heel on floor, lean into wall. Gastrocnemius and soleus stretch.

exercises.name: Wrist Flexor Curl (Rehab)
exercises.description: Very light DB wrist curl. For tennis elbow (reverse) and carpal tunnel rehab.

exercises.name: Finger Extension (Band)
exercises.description: Wrap band around fingers, open hand against resistance. Hand/wrist rehab.

exercises.name: Isometric Quad Set
exercises.description: Seated or supine. Tighten quad without movement. Post-surgery activation.
